craft_notes: Sthāyin: seal-joy (no controller). Close: leaderlessness. Rejected: 'anarchy' — killed; 'automatic' — killed: power kept.

lines: Whatever in Bhairava's Tantra from this succeeds —
by mantra-potency's indwelling power, with none who leads.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yatkiṃcid bhairave tantre sarvam asmāt prasidhyati | mantravīryasamāveśaprabhāvān na niyantriṇā

reads_against.argmap: All in Bhairava-tantra succeeds from this — by mantra-power, no controller.
c1_essence: All in tantra succeeds; mantra-power, no controller.
